create.name: Lisette Schuitemaker
create.bio:
Lisette Schuitemaker is a Dutch author and facilitator who lives in Amsterdam. She studied Classics at Leiden and spent her early career running a communications agency, until a shift in awareness turned her attention to sustainability and inner growth. She sold the business, went to the United States to train in Brennan Healing Science, and for some years kept a private practice helping clients bring more of themselves into their lives. She was a trustee of the Findhorn Foundation in Scotland for close to twenty years, latterly as its chair, and also invests in social and environmental ventures.

Her writing turns the character structures described by Wilhelm Reich, which she met during her Brennan training, into five early conclusions children draw about themselves, and shows how to loosen the critical inner voices they leave behind. Her English titles, published by Inner Traditions and Findhorn Press, include The Childhood Conclusions Fix, The Eldest Daughter Effect, written with the journalist Wies Enthoven, and Childless Living. Each year she co-hosts a retreat for firstborn women at the Findhorn ecovillage with the facilitator Dr. Gill Emslie, and she leads a Dutch online course on the five childhood conclusions. Her website also offers a short free self-test based on the same map.

books.title: The Childhood Conclusions Fix: Turning Negative Self-Talk Around
books.author: Lisette Schuitemaker
books.description: Lisette maps five patterns of self-talk that form in early childhood, such as feeling we do not belong or are never good enough. She explains where each one comes from and the strength hidden behind it, with practical ways to stop believing the old story.

books.title: The Eldest Daughter Effect
books.author: Lisette Schuitemaker, Wies Enthoven
books.description: Written with Wies Enthoven, this book looks at the traits many firstborn women share, from a strong sense of duty to a habit of taking charge. It follows how birth order shapes childhood, friendship, work and love, and how eldest daughters can keep their strengths without carrying everything.

books.title: Childless Living: The Joys and Challenges of Life without Children
books.author: Lisette Schuitemaker
books.description: Drawing on a survey, interviews with more than seventy people in over ten countries and her own life, Lisette describes the seasons of life for people without children, whether by choice or circumstance, and what gives those lives meaning.

courses.title: Eldest Daughter Retreat 2027
courses.description: A long weekend for firstborn women in the Sunshine Room at the Findhorn ecovillage, co-hosted by Lisette and facilitated by Dr. Gill Emslie. The group takes stock of the roles eldest daughters tend to carry, decides what to keep and what to put down, and joins in the community's morning meditation. Sessions, lunches and two dinners are included; accommodation is booked separately.

courses.title: E-learning De 5 kindconclusies
courses.description: A self-paced Dutch-language online course in eight modules, with short films, reflection questions and quizzes, in which Lisette explains the five childhood conclusions and how to work with them. Learners have a year's access and receive a certificate after a final assignment reviewed by Lisette.

free_resources.title: Test your childhood conclusions
free_resources.description: A free online questionnaire that takes a few minutes and shows which of the five childhood conclusions are strongest for you, together with the gifts each one tends to hide and pointers for changing the inner voice.
